# @surfaces-ui/client-connect

Connect client that implements DataSource.

The client side of the dev server's services over Connect: `connectDataSource`, `connectDiscovery`, `connectAgent` and the rest, each implementing the matching interface from `@surfaces-ui/data` or `@surfaces-ui/agent`.

## Install

```bash
npm install @surfaces-ui/client-connect
```

## Part of Surfaces UI

Surfaces UI is a UI library for data and analytics: exploring schemas, querying, charting, tables at scale, chat, and pages an agent can build.
